_comment: Per-project approved-submittal design baselines for auto %-complete (DESIGN.md decision #1, APPROVED by Brad/Jonathan 2026-06-17). Editable by hand. Denominator = approved Garbin design totals. design_lf drives the headline completion %. Update design_columns/design_lf whenever a new Garbin revision is approved, and keep baseline_status 'confirmed' once verified. NEVER fabricate totals — leave baseline_status 'pending' if unconfirmed.

_fields.sp_folder: exact folder name under SharePoint '04 - Project Management/02 - Projects'
_fields.design_columns: approved total pier/column count (latest approved Garbin revision)
_fields.design_lf: approved total linear feet (sum of per-column design depth)
_fields.baseline_status: 'confirmed' = totals verified against approved design; 'pending' = not yet confirmed, do not trust % (installed numbers still shown)
_fields.source_note: where the totals came from / how derived (audit trail)

26-007.name: Madison Lifestyle Garage
26-007.source_note: PROVISIONAL denominator (reproduces Jonathan's ~80% check; NOT yet audit-grade). Shipped parser computes installed = 541 unique production cols / 6973.3 LF. Denominator derived 2026-06-17 by reconciling installed Mob1 GUHMA logs with the approved Mob 2 design table (26-0507 Madison Lifestyle Mob 2 Columns.pdf: 124 design cols / 2064 LF, 114 not-yet-installed): total scope ~= 540 installed + 114 remaining = 654 cols; design LF = 7009.7 installed-actual + 1895 remaining-design = 8905. Note the ~1-col / ~36-LF gap between the manual derivation (540 / 7009.7) and the parser (541 / 6973.3) — a borderline label included by the parser; immaterial to the headline (78.3% LF / 82.7% cols vs derivation's 78.7% / 82.6%). Bid prelim (AP Preliminary Design Madison Lifestyle.xlsx) showed 733 cols/11730 LF at REV-0 before value-engineering removals (e.g. piers 622, 637 removed per submittal markup) and assumed full design depth; that prelim is NOT the approved baseline. NOTE FOR JONATHAN: confirm a single approved Garbin per-column design-depth table exists for Mob1 so design_lf can be set purely from design (not installed-actual) depths, then flip baseline_status to 'confirmed'. ('provisional' still displays the % on the dashboard; only 'pending' withholds it.)
